title: STAR-1: Safer Alignment of Reasoning LLMs with 1K Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model refusal rates and safety compliance using broad safety and jailbreak benchmarks (e.g., StrongReject, JBB-Behaviors, WildChat) that include adversarial and direct prompts requesting hateful, demeaning, or discriminatory content based on protected attributes (e.g., race, religion, gender, sexual orientation).
